notes:
All five findings and the one missing spec item are fixed; nothing was left as accepted-with-reason. FINDING 1 (medium, Ctrl+F hint not demonstrated) — src/Wakeel.UI/Pages/Gallery.razor: the WTreeToolbar of the «الشجرة» section now passes ShowShortcutHint="true" beside BindGlobalShortcut="false", exactly the opt-in the nullable parameter was added for. Confirmed in the running host: the chip is a bdi.w-kbd reading «Ctrl+F» at 586→629 inside the 573→1067 search box, i.e. at the END of the box under RTL, where the A05 pane shows it. (The round-1 reviewer's `.w-gallery-tree kbd` selector could never have matched — Kbd.razor renders , not — but the conclusion was right: with the hint suppressed there was no chip at all.) This also closes the single missing_spec_item. FINDING 2 (low, unisolated pane title) — src/Wakeel.Design/Components/WTreeToolbar.razor: the title is now @Bidi.Wrap(Title) with @using Wakeel.Design.Bidi added. New test Toolbar_Title_Is_Bidi_Isolated renders «شجرة الهيكل Archive 2026» and asserts the Latin+digit run comes back as ONE isolate («⁦Archive 2026⁩», exactly one U+2066) — Bidi.Wrap counts the space between them as a token character, so it is a single run, not two. FINDING 3 (low, dead caret during a search) — src/Wakeel.Design/Components/WTree.razor, Build(): HasChildren is now `HasSearch ? children.Count > 0 : sourceChildren.Count > 0`, so a branch that matches on its own name while its children are filtered out renders no caret and no aria-expanded; `open` is unchanged. New test Search_Leaves_No_Caret_On_A_Branch_Whose_Children_Were_Filtered_Out searches «الاستراتيجي»: 3 rows (the match plus its two kept ancestors), aria-expanded null on the match, 2 carets instead of 3. FINDING 4 (low, dropped task in the sync wrappers) — src/Wakeel.Design/Components/WTree.razor: ExpandAll()/CollapseAll() are now `_ = InvokeAsync(ExpandAllAsync/CollapseAllAsync)`, so a failure inside the caller's ExpandedChanged handler reaches the dispatcher instead of dying with the task. They were kept rather than deleted because the specification names ExpandAll()/CollapseAll() on the API surface; their XML docs now point callers at the Async pair where the result can be awaited, and the gallery still uses the Async pair. FINDING 5 (low, hint line outside the pane) — fixed rather than accepted: WTree gained an optional `Hint` parameter rendering

@Bidi.Wrap(Hint)

after the tree (new .w-tree-hint rule: 8px top margin, 8px inline padding, --w-muted, --w-fs-caption). The gallery moved Ar.Tree.Demo.Hint out of the WSectionHeader Sub into WTree Hint, so the guidance line now sits inside the pane under the last row as in A05 and the text is not duplicated. New test Hint_Is_Printed_Under_The_Last_Row asserts the text and that the hint follows in the markup. BUILD / TESTS (exact chain, run twice, last run after the host check): dotnet build src/Wakeel.Design --no-dependencies; dotnet build src/Wakeel.UI --no-dependencies; dotnet build tests/Wakeel.UI.Tests --no-dependencies; dotnet test tests/Wakeel.UI.Tests --no-build --filter "FullyQualifiedName~WTree"; dotnet build src/Wakeel.Desktop — all green, 0 warnings each (TreatWarningsAsErrors clean). Passed! 26/26 (22 kept + 4 new). The first Wakeel.Desktop build failed on a file lock (MSB3027/MSB3021: Wakeel.Design.dll and Wakeel.UI.dll held by another agent's running Wakeel.Desktop, pid 27708); per protocol I waited and retried instead of touching anything, and it built clean once that host exited. HOST RUN — Wakeel.Desktop.exe, --remote-debugging-port=9335, --window-size=1366x768, fresh empty temp --data-folder, --start-url=/gallery; /json/version answered (Edg/153.0.4234.32) and this time the start-url WAS honoured (location.pathname = /gallery). Two screenshots over CDP (JPEG, 1366px), dark and light (light forced with data-theme="light" on ), each looked at once. Measured in the pane: width 520px, 10 rows all 38px tall and all ending at x=1067, caret rights 1050/1030/1010 (20px per depth), hint top 546 against last-row bottom 538 — the hint is inside the pane, under the last row, no overlap or clipping. Host log held exactly one line («Wakeel desktop host starting up»); process killed, 0 Wakeel.Desktop processes left, TCP 9335 closed. SIDE BY SIDE vs design/exports/preview/light/A/«A05 — الهيكلية.jpg» (opened once): header order title → count badge → توسيع الكل → طي الكل matches; the search row spans the pane with the magnifier at the start and the Ctrl+F chip at the end — now identical (this was the round-2 finding); row anatomy caret → icon → name → level chip → (badge) → gap → state/meta matches; level-chip palette هيئة primary / دائرة info / قسم success / وحدة neutral matches; selected-row full-width tint and attention row amber tint with ⚠ «بلا رئيس معيّن» at the end match; the in-pane footer hint is now present in the same position as the preview's move hint. Two remaining differences, both deliberate gallery demonstration rather than screen deviation: the gallery sets Movable="true" so the optional ⋮ reorder handle shows on every row (A05 does not switch it on; the spec calls the handle optional and the gallery's job is to show every state), and the gallery adds a dimmed out-of-service row that A05 has no example of. The hint wording differs from A05's («مقبض الترتيب…» vs «اسحب الوحدة…») because the gallery has no «نقل وحدة» button to refer to; the A05 screen will pass its own text into the same parameter. Dark theme re-checked on the same section after the change: chip, hint line, chips, attention tint and border, dimmed row, selection tint and handle all read correctly, nothing clipped. TEXT / SECURITY re-checked: no MarkupString anywhere in the package, the search highlight is still built with RenderTreeBuilder over plain text plus a real ; all user-facing strings Arabic with no technical terms, ports, servers or codes; no secrets in logs or UI state. SCOPE: only allowed paths were touched. WButton.razor, Ar.Shell.cs and the b2-screens Wakeel.UI pages were not modified in this round; Ar.Common.cs and Enums.cs needed no further additions.
